marks.gloss_en: אי מה משרת — בעל מום לא, אף כהן מברך — בעל מום לא! -- the stam: the juxtaposition would carry over the ministering priest's blemish disqualification too
הא איתקש לנזיר -- he is also juxtaposed to the nazirite [for whom a blemish is no bar]
they are rabbinic supports (asmachtot), and [are juxtaposed] to leniency
שתים עשרה ביריחו?! נפישן להו טובא -- twelve in Jericho besides twenty-four elsewhere would be too many
אלא: שתים עשרה מהן ביריחו (= p_shteim_esre_mehen)
the baraita as worded: twenty-four watches in Eretz Yisrael, and twelve in Jericho
מיתיבי: ובא דוד ושמואל והעמידן על עשרים וארבע -- not Shmuel sixteen then David twenty-four
הכי קאמר: מיסודו של דוד ושמואל הרמתי העמידום על עשרים וארבע -- the baraita does not say they made 24 at once (= p_miyesodo_david_ushmuel)
the baraita: David and Shmuel came and established them as twenty-four
אמר לך רב חמא בר גוריא: תנאי היא, ואנא דאמרי כי האי תנא דאמר שמונה (= p_rchbg_kehai_tanna)
Rav Chama bar Gurya [as the stam voices him]: it is a dispute of tannaim, and I spoke like the tanna who said eight
the early prophets instituted twenty-four priestly watches
kohanim and leviim are indispensable to the offering (in both lists)
Moshe instituted for Israel eight watches, four from Elazar and four from Itamar
the other baraita: Moshe instituted sixteen watches, eight from Elazar and eight from Itamar
the stam: lest you say Itamar's sons too increased, their eight having been four at first -- 'taken, taken for Itamar' teaches that Itamar's stayed as they were
four watches came up from the exile: Yedaya, Charim, Pashchur and Imer
the mishnah: these are the maamadot -- since it is stated 'Command the children of Israel'
